name: eli5-technical-explanation
description: Simplify complex technical concepts using everyday analogies and progressive disclosure
steps: Identify the core concept to explain
Find everyday analogy (car engine, plumbing, etc.)
Use progressive disclosure: simple first, details on demand
Provide deep-dive reference for advanced readers
triggers: how does Y work in simple terms?
examples: RPC tensor padding is like... making sure puzzle pieces fit even if they're odd sizes
Distributed inference is like... dividing a book among friends to read faster
LoRA fine-tuning is like... learning to drive a new car without forgetting how to ride a bike
